description: This script performs linear programming-based analysis of Triton matrix multiplication configurations, parsing logs to optimize template selection for performance tuning.

methods.name: parse_log_file
methods.description: Parses a JSON log file to count occurrences and extract benchmark timings.

methods.name: optimize_templates
methods.description: Uses linear programming to select optimal Triton templates based on log data to minimize total weighted matrix multiplication time.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that parses logs and runs optimization over a range of template counts.
